simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֶשְׁתּוֹן (H850) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֶשְׁתּוֹן (ʼEshtôwn) means Eshton , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 11.

definitions.full: H850. Eshton אֶשְׁתּוֺן proper name, masculine a man of Judah (perhaps from אֵשֶׁת = effeminate or uxorious ) 1Chr 4:11-12 ,.
definitions.rootNote: probably from the same as 7764 ; restful;
